01 /

For adults only

EDGE is intended for people aged 18 and over. Do not use the platform if you are under 18 or if participation is prohibited where you are. Keep your login details private and away from children.

02 /

Set a personal budget

Decide what you can afford to lose before placing a stake. Keep money for bills, food, housing and savings separate. Do not borrow to stake or treat potential returns as income you can rely on.

03 /

Do not chase a result

A previous loss does not make a win more likely. Increasing stakes to recover losses can increase harm. Copy strategies can also lose consecutive games or the entire allocation. Take time away if you feel pressure to continue.

04 /

Pause your next move

You can pause a copy position to stop future copied picks. Existing stakes still settle. For other account concerns, contact an administrator through support. Pausing a strategy is not an account-wide self-exclusion tool.

05 /

Recognise when you need support

If staking affects your finances, relationships, sleep or wellbeing, stop and speak to someone you trust or a qualified support professional in your country. Account support can discuss platform activity, but it does not provide clinical advice.

KEEP YOUR NEXT MOVE CLEAR.

THE DETAILS MAKE THE DIFFERENCE.
